title: Preserve the full lesion field without reducing acquired detail
status: engineering qualification only; scientific launch requires review
supersedes: native-windows-2 as the proposed scientific input; native source audit remains reusable evidence
reason: Training geometry exposed native axis spacing up to 10 mm. Native 144-voxel windows therefore had excessive physical-scale variation despite perfect target preservation.
spacing: For each closest-RAS source axis, factor=max(1,ceil(spacing_mm-1e-5)); subdivide each acquired voxel cell by that integer. No spatial downsampling. Resulting axis spacing is at most 1.00001 mm.
orientation: Lossless closest-RAS reorientation; preserve acquired obliquity and exact physical field edges
image_interpolation: Linear interpolation of HU-windowed normalized CT; no dense fine-grid cache
target_interpolation: Nearest neighbor on integer subdivisions; source labels remain unchanged
inference: All full-CT fine-grid tiles selected using CT geometry only. Interpolate tile probabilities at original native voxel centers and blend with positive triangular weights. Invert the axis reorientation after argmax.
sampling: Retain case permutation. Cycle complete lesion-field coverage windows then component-centered jitter; every fourth visit is uniform CT. Empty cases cover the pancreas then use one pancreas anchor. Require full annotated-field exposure within 18 visits.
gates: Every native annotation voxel accounted for
No inference use of annotation crops
Real pilot and bounded CUDA checkpoint/cold-restore qualification
resource_policy: One native source case at a time per worker; on-demand 144-cubed fine windows; native-grid reconstruction accumulators. Combined audit RSS 12 GiB, C/E free floors 100 GiB. Reuse completed native CT-content checks; no repeat duplicate research or full CT payload audit.
scientific_claim: A bundled coverage, representation, sampling and inference intervention; no learned-Dice improvement established by engineering checks. Lower-learning-rate trial remains deferred.
